description: Discriminate the c₃ bar-odd swing's functional form: the PR #4064 synthesis's self-dual/CS-degeneration POLE form (swing ≈ 1/|u²−1|, a 'rigidity divergence' at q*) vs the MERGED capstone's 1/u³ LADDER artifact (#3600/#3636/#3654). Deterministic extractor S(q)=c3_target_at+Vol(4₁), full precision. (1) q* is a SIMPLE zero — S'(q*)≈3.84e6 and S''(q*)≈−3.70e8 both FINITE ⇒ no pole/branch point, so Φ_odd∝S does not diverge at q*; the 'rigidity divergence at the self-dual locus' has no support there. (2) The pole form 1/|u²−1|≈1.00007 (u=b·ℏ_q²≈0.0085, u²≈7.3e-5) is O(1) — ~6 orders of magnitude below the measured swing; q₀ is NOT near a u²→1 locus. (3) The swing IS 1/u³: S'(q*)=2.37×(1/u³), smooth O(1) prefactor (capstone). Scope-(a) REFUTATION of the pole reinterpretation; the 1/u³ capstone stands. SURVIVES: q* remains a fixed simple zero (CS→0/ε=0), a third decay-sector determination of q₀ — but the swing and q* are separate facts coinciding at q*, not evidence for a pole. No c_k wired; no fit; C14; no tier change.
